title: Additivity of the coordinate Laplacian
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and consider real-valued functions on $\Omega^n$. For every coordinate $i$, the product coordinate Laplacian is additive: its value on $f+g$ is the sum of its values on $f$ and $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
